Macro backdrop remains geopolitics-heavy with 50% unscheduled news risk.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics holds the top momentum rank and a durable uptrend (hurst trend) without crowding, while rotation is still narrowing and no handoff is confirmed. The coincident leadership picture favours persistence, though the detector provides no alpha edge and this market's mean-reversion tendency warns against extrapolation.
